# Sirach Chapter 25 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 25 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**25:1** In-three-things I-was-made-beautiful and I-stood-up before-the-LORD and before-men: concord among-brothers, and love-of-neighbors, and a-man-and-wife who-are-well-matched with-each-other.

**25:2** Three-kinds of-persons my-soul-hates, and I-was-greatly-disgusted with-their-life: a-poor-man-of-arrogance, and a-rich-man-of-falsehood, and an-elder who-commits-adultery lacking-understanding.

**25:3** In-your-youth you-did-not-gather — and how-will-you-find in-your-old-age?

**25:4** How-beautiful is-the-judgment of-gray-hair and the-knowing-of-counsel among-elders!

**25:5** How-beautiful is the-wisdom of-old-men, and thought and counsel to-those-who-are-honored!

**25:6** A-great-thing is the-experience of-the-elders, and a-crown of-glory is the-fear of-the-LORD.

**25:7** Nine-thoughts I-have-blessed in-my-heart, and the-tenth I-will-speak with-my-tongue: a-man-who-rejoices in-his-children; a-man-who-lives-to-see the-fall of-his-enemies;

**25:8** blessed-is he-who-dwells with-a-sensible-wife; and he-who-has-not-slipped with-his-tongue; and he-who-has-not-served one-inferior-to-himself;

**25:9** blessed-is he-who-has-found understanding; and he-who-speaks in-the-ears of-those-who-listen;

**25:10** how-great is he-who-has-found wisdom! But-there-is-none-greater than he-who-fears the-LORD.

**25:11** The-fear of-the-LORD surpasses all-else; he-who-holds-it — to-what-can he-be-compared?

**25:13** Any-wound but-not the-wound of-the-heart! Any-evil but-not the-evil of a-woman!

**25:14** Any-affliction but-not the-affliction of-those-who-hate! And any-vengeance but-not the-vengeance of-enemies!

**25:15** There-is-no-head above the-head of a-serpent, and there-is-no-wrath above the-wrath of an-enemy.

**25:16** I-would-prefer to-dwell with a-lion and a-dragon than to-dwell with an-evil-woman.

**25:17** The-wickedness of a-woman changes her-countenance, and she-darkens her-face like a-bear's; and like a-sackcloth her-husband will-show-himself in-the-midst-of-his-neighbors.

**25:18** A-short-patience [turned] into a-sigh, and a-downcast-heart — a-wife who-does-not-make-happy her-husband.

**25:19** Every-evil is-small compared-to the-evil of a-woman; let-the-lot of-sinners fall-upon her.

**25:20** Like-an-ascent-of-sand in-the-feet of-the-aged — so is a-garrulous-wife to a-quiet-man.

**25:21** Do-not-be-taken-in by the-beauty of a-woman, and do-not-desire a-woman for-her-beauty.

**25:22** Anger and insolence and great-shame [it-is when] a-wife provides-for her-husband.

**25:23** A-downcast-heart and a-sad-face and a-wound-of-the-heart — an-evil-wife. Hands-dropping and knees-gone-slack — the-wife who-does-not-make-her-husband-happy.

**25:24** From a-woman the-beginning of-sin, and because-of-her we-all-die.

**25:25** Do-not-give to-water an-outlet, and to an-evil-wife permission to-spread-herself.

**25:26** If she-walks-not by-your-hand, cut-her-off from your-flesh.
